instruction.name: movgr2fr.w
instruction.description: Move the low 32 bits of rj into fd.

experiments.name: high-unroll memory-assisted chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 1; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 0' --asm 'movgr2fr.w $f0, $r4; fst.d $f0, $r12, 0; ld.d $r4, $r12, 0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'
experiments.notes: 12.05-cycle chain minus 11.04 cycles (10.04 FPR-store -> GPR-load forwarding + 1 add.d) = 1.01 cycles. Measured with unroll=100000; unroll=1000 gave 0.95 because per-call overhead was not fully amortised.

latencies.notes: GPR -> FPR latency is 1 cycle. The full movgr2fr.d + movfr2gr.d round trip is 4 cycles; inserting fadd or fmul changes it by exactly the inserted latency, so the round trip is additive. This rules out a 3+2 split for the .d/.w/.s moves.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2fr.w $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.w $f1, $r5; movgr2fr.w $f2, $r6; movgr2fr.w $f3, $r7; movgr2fr.w $f4, $r8; movgr2fr.w $f5, $r9; movgr2fr.w $f6, $r10; movgr2fr.w $f7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2fr.w $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.w $f1, $r5; movgr2fr.w $f2, $r6; movgr2fr.w $f3, $r7; movgr2fr.w $f4, $r8; movgr2fr.w $f5, $r9; movgr2fr.w $f6, $r10; movgr2fr.w $f7, $r11'

notes: Individual GPR->FPR latency is 1 cycle. Round trip with movfr2gr.d is 4 cycles; high-half round trip movgr2frh.w + movfrh2gr.s is 5 cycles. 3+2 cycles for movgr2fr/movfr2gr is incompatible with the 4-cycle full round trip. Throughput is 1 CPI for 1-20 independent lanes.
